failed_or_abandoned: First solar capture run treated WimPyC densities as g/cm^3 (they are normalised to M/R^3): mass integral 0.17 Msun and capture rates x5.9 too low; corrected and verified (mass integral 1.000 Msun, agreement with WimPyC 0.1-2%).
lz.helm_F2 is scalar-only; replaced by a vectorised copy checked to 1e-12.
First non-thermalised annihilation volume used the threshold radius r_thr; replaced by the apoapsis radius from energy conservation.
A quantitative ELT/TMT exposure estimate was not attempted (sensitivities not reliably recalled); only a qualitative statement is made.
